rationale: 規範 is a normative behavioral model; 基準 is a criterion, including measurable standards.
規定 is a formulated provision; 規範 is a norm of proper conduct, not necessarily written.
強行 carries out an intention despite resistance; 強制 makes someone act.
Same reading きょうこう does not imply shared meaning: forced action versus panic/crisis.
禁物 is something to avoid; 厳禁 is a strict prohibition.
厳禁 strengthens the prohibition compared with neutral 禁止.
決行 emphasizes resolve; 強行 emphasizes resistance/adverse conditions.
厳禁 establishes a strict ban; 厳守 means comply strictly.
誤差 is measurement/error deviation; 差額 is a monetary difference.
合併 often denotes merger into one organization; 統合 is broader integration.
混沌 is an undefined state; 混乱 is disruption/disarray.
